pages.title: Crazy Driver
pages.creator: SumSum Games
pages.description: Crazy Driver puts a customizable voxel car on destructive driving courses. Break through walls, collect rewards and work through the stages with your chosen vehicle. Use steering, braking and jumping to deal with the next obstacle.

pages.title: Sky Golfer
pages.creator: JazzCat Studio
pages.description: Sky Golfer makes the course itself your way of guiding a golf ball. Rotate the platform structure clockwise or counterclockwise and let gravity move the ball toward the hole. Adjust the angle carefully so it follows the route you need.

pages.title: Mystic Link
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Mystic Link asks you to connect three or more matching jewels in a single move. Longer chains can create bombs or restore moves, giving you more ways to continue. Watch the skill and fever gauges while planning the next connection.

pages.title: Two RX7 Drifters
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Two RX7 Drifters lets you slide modified cars around three tracks, alone or with a second player. Customize paint, rims and underglow before taking the cars out. Practice controlling a drift through corners while comparing your driving with a friend.

pages.title: K-Wedding Dream
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: K Wedding Dream lets you style a Korean couple for their wedding. Choose makeup, hairstyles and clothing that combine traditional influences with modern options. Finish both looks and save a picture of the couple in their chosen outfits.

pages.title: Butterfly Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Butterfly Sort challenges you to gather four butterflies of the same kind on one leaf or stem. Move them between the available positions while respecting the matching-kind rule. Keep enough room free to separate mixed groups and complete the arrangement.

pages.title: Sand Blast
pages.creator: QiGame
pages.description: Sand Blast turns placed blocks into falling grains of colored sand. Arrange the drops so one color connects across the board and clears away. Plan where the sand will settle before the growing pile uses up the available room.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot Challenge
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Italian Brainrot Challenge tests your knowledge of the internet characters through multiple-choice questions. Read each prompt and choose the answer you think fits. Work through the questions and build a score as the challenge changes in difficulty.

pages.title: Sprunki Easter Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Sprunki Easter Coloring gives you spring-themed character pictures to decorate. Choose colors and apply them to the drawing, building an Easter palette of your own. Try different combinations to change the mood of each finished character.

pages.title: The Best Warrior
pages.creator: Briuor
pages.description: Best Warrior begins with training against a dummy to increase your attack strength. Fight enemies for gold, spend the earnings on improvements and work toward tougher bosses. Skins, chests and timed rewards add more things to collect during the progression.

pages.title: Baling Bum
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Baling Bum is a physics puzzle about guiding a character to its destination using movable supports. Drag or rotate the blocks to change how the route works. Check the resulting angles before sending the character onward through the level.

pages.title: Rummy 500 Card Game
pages.creator: MINDWAYTECH CONSULTING SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED
pages.description: Rummy 500 brings the card game to matches against computer opponents. Choose the classic format, a three-player game or the speed variation, then organize your hand into useful combinations. Automatic card arrangement and saved progress help you manage the ongoing match.

pages.title: My Cottagecore Aesthetic Look
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Cottagecore Look gives Elsa, Anna and Ariel wardrobes inspired by country living. Choose clothing and accessories for each character and build a coordinated outfit. Explore the softer, rustic fashion options to give the princesses their own cottagecore styles.

pages.title: Fruit Merge Reloaded
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Fruit Merge Reloaded combines identical fruits to create the next form. Place the pieces with future merges in mind and keep working toward larger fruit. Manage the space around each combination so the growing collection leaves room for another move.

pages.title: Battle Island 2
pages.creator: Devshifu Studio
pages.description: Battle Island 2 sends you into encounters with wild monsters and rival trainers. Win battles to earn money and develop your own monster army. Strengthen the team as you work toward defeating the island's trainers.

pages.title: Football Stars
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Football Stars turns Bollywood actors into football competitors. Pick your character, move into position and use kicks or headers to score. Finish the 90-second match with more goals than the opponent to claim the win.

pages.title: Action King: Draw Fight
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Action King Draw Fight puts the fighter's pose under your control. Drag the joints to reposition the body, dodge incoming blows and create a counterattack. Read the opponent's movement before deciding how to shape your next response.

pages.title: Mini Push
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Mini Push asks you to guide a small blob by changing the blocks around its route. Enable or disable platforms to open the way while avoiding enemies. Time each adjustment so the character can continue toward the objective safely.

pages.title: Flip Skater Idle
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Flip Skater Idle pairs two skaters on an obstacle-filled course. Adjust their positions to avoid barriers while collecting stars along the route. Keep both riders in mind as you work through the stages together.

pages.title: Fruit Slide 2
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Fruit Slide 2 asks you to draw a shape that will repeat its movement across the play area. Design the path to slice every fruit while avoiding bombs. Consider the whole pattern before starting, since a safe first cut may lead into danger later.

pages.title: Kitchen Bazar
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Kitchen Bazar puts you in charge of preparing food during a busy service. Select the ingredients needed for each customer's order and keep the meals moving. Use the money earned from serving customers to develop the restaurant further.

pages.title: Maze & labyrinth
pages.creator: 7thReactor
pages.description: Maze Labyrinth challenges you to find an exit through winding passages. Choose a classic maze or try the shaded variation, then trace a route through the walls. Zoom in on larger maps when you need a closer look at the next junction.

pages.title: Buggy Wuggy - Platformer Playtime
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Buggy Wuggy follows a child through a hazardous platform adventure. Run and jump past monsters while looking for the white exit door. Watch the obstacles ahead so a hurried escape does not carry you into the next threat.

pages.title: Get 11 - Puzzle
pages.creator: Dinmo Games
pages.description: Get 11 is a number-merging puzzle about bringing equal blocks together. Combine matching values to create higher numbers and work toward eleven. Think about the pieces left around each merge so the board continues offering useful combinations.

pages.title: Switch Color
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Switch Color asks you to move a colored ball through rotating shapes. Pass only through sections that match the ball's current color. Time the jumps around the turning barriers and recheck the colors before attempting the next opening.

pages.title: Blocks Fill Tangram Puzzle
pages.creator: Drmop Games
pages.description: Blocks Fill Tangram gives you shaped pieces to fit into an empty grid. Drag each piece from the panel and arrange the full set without leaving gaps. Change the difficulty to try more demanding layouts after completing the easier boards.

pages.title: Saw Machine.io
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Saw Machine IO turns a vehicle into a weapon on a survival platform. Drive into opponents with the attacking tool mounted at the front while protecting your own position. Stay on the platform as you try to eliminate the other machines.

pages.title: EZ Yoga
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: EZ Yoga presents a sequence of poses as a timed daily activity. Follow the displayed positions and move through the routine at the game's pace. Use the session to explore the available exercises and complete the day's sequence.

pages.title: 1010 Animals Tetriz
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: 1010 Animals Tetriz asks you to place groups of animal blocks onto a grid. Fill a horizontal or vertical line of ten to clear space for more pieces. Consider the shape of the next group before leaving a narrow gap you cannot use.

pages.title: Pixelkenstein Halloween
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Pixelkenstein Halloween is a platform adventure about gathering candy. Run and jump through the levels while collecting the seasonal treats. Keep an eye on the route ahead so each attempt brings you through more of the stage.

pages.title: Kids Movie Night
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Kids Movie Night lets you help run a cinema and prepare a film event. Assist customers, arrange seats and snacks, and work on the movie's presentation. Choose details such as its poster, title or theme as the activities unfold.

pages.title: Crazy Monsters Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Crazy Monsters Memory hides pairs of monster pictures across four levels. Turn over two cards at a time and remember what appears beneath them. Clear each layout while trying to use fewer turns than on your previous attempt.

pages.title: Extreme Fighters
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Extreme Fighters lets you choose between three characters for an action run. Jump past danger, shoot enemies and collect useful supplies such as ammunition, shields and extra lives. Keep advancing while building your score from the encounters.

pages.title: Corona Virus Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Corona Virus Memory is a picture-pairing game spread across four levels. Reveal cards, remember the images and match identical pairs to remove them. Concentrate on the locations already shown so each turn helps clear more of the board.

pages.title: Night Time Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Night Cars Jigsaw offers twelve nighttime car pictures to assemble. Choose an easy, medium or hard puzzle with 25, 49 or 100 pieces. Match the vehicles, lights and surrounding details to reconstruct the selected scene.

pages.title: Princess eGirl vs softGirl
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Princess Egirl vs Softgirl compares two fashion styles through a dress-up contest. Choose clothing and accessories for the competing looks, exploring the different wardrobes. Put together an outfit that expresses each style before viewing the finished results.

pages.title: Shoot The Robbers
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Shoot Robbers puts hostile targets in the windows of a house. Aim at the robbers and fire before their return shots put you in danger. Watch the whole building so you can react when another target appears.

pages.title: Crazy Road
pages.creator: KasoiGame
pages.description: Crazy Road challenges you to keep a car moving while avoiding crashes. Steer through the road layout and react to the other vehicles. Watch approaching traffic and adjust the car's position before a gap closes.

pages.title: Eatable Numbers
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Eatable Numbers puts you in control of a red numbered object surrounded by blue targets. Hit only numbers smaller than your own and avoid the larger ones. Keep comparing the values as the action speeds up.

pages.title: Ambulance Rescue Game Ambulance helicopter
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Ambulance Rescue Game Ambulance Helicopter puts you behind the wheel of an ambulance. Drive toward injured people and complete the rescue tasks within the available time. Follow the route carefully while keeping control of the emergency vehicle.

pages.title: Desert Shooter
pages.creator: Yup7.com
pages.description: Desert Shooter puts armed characters into a multiplayer battle across a desert setting. Choose among three fighters with different weapons, then move and jump to find a useful position. Use gunfire or close attacks while watching the opposing players.

pages.title: Farmers Market Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Farmers Market Match 3 asks you to line up matching farm-themed items in groups of three. Keep making combinations to score and stop the meter on the left from falling too low. Look for another match before the remaining supply runs out.

pages.title: Barrier
pages.creator: Jam Game Studio
pages.description: Barrier sends a car along a hazardous road with stars to collect. Move left or right to avoid obstacles while trying to gather the rewards. React to the changing gaps as the driving speed increases.

pages.title: Crazy Monkey
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Crazy Monkey is a bridge-building timing challenge. Hold to grow a stick, then release when you think it is long enough to reach the next platform. A stick that falls short or extends too far ends the crossing.

pages.title: Rocket Road
pages.creator: Play.works
pages.description: Rocket Road sends a color-changing craft along a route filled with obstacles. Steer to find a clear path and react to the road ahead. Keep the vehicle under control as the flight continues through the changing course.

pages.title: OnPipe
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: On Pipe asks you to control a cutter as it strips material from a pipe. Hold to cut and watch the obstacles interrupting the surface. Release at the right moment so the tool can pass each barrier safely.

pages.title: Ancient Aztec Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Aztec Coloring lets you decorate eight themed pictures with a palette of 23 colors. Select an image and fill its different areas to build your design. Save the finished artwork when you are happy with the chosen colors.

pages.title: Halloween Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Halloween Puzzle Challenge gives you seasonal pictures to rebuild from jigsaw pieces. Study the scattered parts and fit their edges and details together. Complete the selected image to reveal the full Halloween scene.

pages.title: Dumb Pacman
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Dumb Pacman sends you through a dot-filled maze while monsters give chase. Gather the dots and avoid enemies until a larger power dot gives you a chance to turn the tables. Keep watching for returning monsters as you finish the remaining passages.

pages.title: Can I Eat It
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Can I Eat It asks you to decide whether the object shown to a girl is something she can eat. Select yes or no for each pictured item. Keep examining the new objects as the game tests your choices.

pages.title: Control The Truck
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Control Truck is a survival driving challenge in which clicks change the truck's direction. Watch its movement and choose when to turn before it reaches danger. React to the vehicle's unpredictable motion to keep the attempt going.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Dental Care
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Dental follows Hazel through a fictional dental visit after a toothache. Help with the activities around her appointment and respond to what she needs. Follow the game's prompts as the dentist attends to the little patient.

pages.title: FPS Sniper Shooter: Battle Survival
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: FPS Sniper Battle Survival puts you into a first-person firefight against hostile forces. Move through the combat area and use the mouse to aim and fire. Look for a position that gives you a clear shot while limiting exposure to enemy attacks.

pages.title: Bubble Farm
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Bubble Farm fills its levels with colored bubbles for you to clear. Aim a shot toward matching colors and make groups of at least three to burst them. Choose placements that create space for the next shot and help complete the stage.

pages.title: Easter Puzzle Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Easter Puzzle Time offers spring-themed jigsaws with three difficulty choices. Select a picture and reconnect the pieces at your own pace, with no timer to rush the assembly. Use the colors and edges to work toward the complete scene.

pages.title: Temple Puzzle
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Temple Puzzle uses gravity and movable objects to clear green blocks. Work out how the other blocks, explosions and bouncing effects can knock the targets away. Each stage asks you to arrange a useful chain of physical interactions.

pages.title: Moto X3M Pool Party
pages.creator: MadPuffers
pages.description: Moto X3M Pool Party puts a motorbike on waterpark-themed stunt courses. Accelerate, brake and adjust the bike's angle to cross jumps and avoid traps. Time each approach so the rider can land safely and continue toward the finish.

pages.title: Super Fairy Powers
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Super Fairy Powers uses a fidget spinner challenge to help a fairy recover her flying ability. Spin to build the required score and work toward the target. Keep improving the result until the fairy's powers can be restored.

pages.title: Being Pretty Bride
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Being Pretty Bride helps Nancy prepare her wedding-day look. Browse the available bridal clothing and put together an outfit for the occasion. Choose the pieces that work together before viewing the finished bride.

pages.title: Summer Fashion Couples
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Summer Fashion Couples lets you style high-school couples for the season. Explore the clothing options and coordinate outfits for the characters. Put summer colors and accessories together to create a different look for each pair.

pages.title: Number  7
pages.creator: Two Hands Lab
pages.description: Number 7 combines number merging with movement across a small grid. Bring at least three equal numbers together to create a higher value, keeping a clear path for each move. Reaching seven can clear its row and column, opening space for more combinations.

pages.title: Fidget Spinner Multiplayers
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fidget Spinner Multiplayers turns spinners into competitors inside a circular arena. Control yours against four online opponents and try to push their spinners outside the boundary. Protect your own position while working toward the leaderboard.

pages.title: Exotic Princess Brain Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Exotic Princess Brain Doctor is a fictional clinic game starring a princess. Follow the examination prompts and use the pictured tools to deal with the game's unusual objects. Work through the treatment activities until the patient is ready to leave.

pages.title: Uggs Clean n' Care
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Uggs Clean and Care gives you a pair of boots to freshen up. Work through the cleaning and care activities using the tools provided. Attend to the different parts of the footwear and complete its makeover.

pages.title: Chino Run
pages.creator: ZGames
pages.description: Chino Run is a runner with jumping, coins and a score to improve. Time your jumps around the objects along the route while trying to keep the character moving. Collect what you can without losing track of the next obstacle.

pages.title: Hockey Shootout
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Hockey Shootout asks you to send a puck past the goalkeeper. Swipe to choose the shot's direction and strength, then watch where it travels. Adjust the next attempt to find a better opening in the goal.

pages.title: Best Party Outfits for Princesses
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Best Party Outfits gives Ariel and Aurora three occasions to dress for. Choose a red-carpet look, a relaxed picnic outfit and clothing for an outdoor cafe visit. Match the wardrobe choices to each event and finish both princesses' styles.

pages.title: Football Penalty Go
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Football Penalty Go puts you at the penalty spot against a goalkeeper. Choose your shot and try to send the ball into the net. Build your team's goal total while aiming to finish ahead of the opposition.

pages.title: Apple Shooter 1
pages.creator: Andrew Wolf
pages.description: Apple Shooter 1 challenges you to hit an apple resting on another character. Aim carefully before firing and keep the shot away from the person underneath it. Judge the line to the apple to complete the target challenge.
